description: SvComboBox in Svelte 5 as a form field: type to filter a grouped, portalled list where the value must come from the list, so unmatched text reverts on blur. Shown as a currency picker with a label, a clear button and required validation, on the shared editor contract.

faq.question: What happens if the user types something not in the list?
faq.answer: On blur the text reverts to the current value, or clears if there is none, so the field never reports a value outside its options.

faq.question: How is the list filtered?
faq.answer: Case-insensitively on the label as you type, keeping group headings for groups that still have matches; arrow keys move through the matches and Enter picks.

faq.question: Can options load from a server?
faq.answer: Yes. Pass loadOptions instead of options for a debounced remote search, which the remote combo box demo shows.
